scope: All18 original majors, all45 cNMF components versus all permitted Spectra factors including unstable factors; each major requires both independent diagnostic audits.
metrics: Median matched3seed L2 Spectra gene weights vs positive cNMF coefficients; common-axis cosine and native-axis zero-padded cosine with retained norm fraction; full top50 Jaccard; all3 seeds pooled/source/source-node residual score rho. No seed/K selection or formal state threshold.
audit: Every cosine scalar check; deterministic20pairs perK, all3seeds/all3contexts independently scipy Spearman checked; source/cell/gene identities and hashes asserted.
